comments.text:
Won't happen.
Google, Nvidia, Tesla and Co. so far could not really even solve "driverless" driving for normal cars in over 10 years?
Now imagine this for a Truck with more safety rules and a complete different way. The AI / Computer have to calculate everything from new because Trucks are slower, wider, bigger, longer, heavier and and and. With a movable trailer the AI is going bonkers instantly.

This adds so much more variance to a driverless solution that you would need even better hardware and scanning tools and much more trainng data to train the AI to learn how to drive with a truck.
Nvidia and Co. already need to train the AI with "AI generated" input data because the already existing videos from archives or ripped dashcam footages, are not in terabytes, not in petabytes, at least in Exabytes and its still not enough.

Who would invest in this and start with the training when it would take like 10-20y+?
Doubt that any CEO or State want a Truck testing-driving and rush with a few tons into a busting city


We Humans, or better said we "drivers", on average, avoid crashes by 99.9%.
The AI would altleast need to have the same rate or even higher/better to get a pass.
